donor_fact: Root and grammatical morphology contribute distinct semantic material.
bilqis_disposition: Separate root identity, feature tuple, relation role and scope in typed AST.
acceptance_test: Reject root/features flattened into one unconstrained text field.

donor_fact: Configuration distinguishes arrangements involving number, similarity and connection.
bilqis_disposition: First configuration-inspired family uses cardinality, color uniformity and induced-graph connectivity. These are task choices, not exhaustive donor meanings.
acceptance_test: All eight three-node graphs and all nonempty subsets agree between independent evaluators.

donor_fact: Affiliation concerns functional relationships among members.
bilqis_disposition: Keep affiliation separate from cardinality and graph edges. Future world needs jointly specified purposes and role relations.
acceptance_test: Same graph with different functional coordination must remain representationally distinguishable.

donor_fact: Monadic, agglomerative, nomic and abstract perspective are not simply singular/plural alternatives.
bilqis_disposition: Introduce group-view scope later; do not label the current integer count as Perspective.
acceptance_test: A multi-member object can retain monadic treatment; scope tests must cover this.

donor_fact: Extension differentiates the portion or phase of a referent under consideration.
bilqis_disposition: Require temporal/part structure before mapping extensions into targets.
acceptance_test: Snapshot identity is insufficient to prove extension equivalence.

donor_fact: Essence distinguishes normal from representative reference.
bilqis_disposition: Add explicit referential interpretation, not an ungrounded real/imaginary binary.
acceptance_test: Representative relation must bind to a referent with provenance.

donor_fact: These categories and the CA complex occupy distinct formative functions.
bilqis_disposition: Maintain independent schema namespaces; no ad hoc CA bundle used as an answer token.
acceptance_test: Typed-field confusion and missing-default tests.

donor_fact: Cases encode relations and roles beyond a single generic edge.
bilqis_disposition: Extend Relation with role, source, target and frame; reject implicit nearest-noun binding.
acceptance_test: Round-trip role swaps and arity changes must preserve or reject meaning explicitly.

donor_fact: Applicative concerns contextual use rather than inherent intended function.
bilqis_disposition: APL(entity,value) compares the finite-world actual-use field.
acceptance_test: Change actual use only; PUR result must remain unchanged.

donor_fact: Purposive concerns dedicated or intended purpose.
bilqis_disposition: PUR(entity,value) compares the separately declared intended-purpose field.
acceptance_test: Change intended purpose only; APL result must remain unchanged.

donor_fact: A case label has a relational interpretation within its construction.
bilqis_disposition: Compile role-bearing frames before broad lexical expansion; do not treat all cases as interchangeable unary attributes.
acceptance_test: Frame validation must reject dangling role bindings and wrong argument types.

donor_fact: Valence modifies participation structure.
bilqis_disposition: Future event AST needs participants and participation relations before valence teaching.
acceptance_test: Swap actor/participant without changing event identity and test expected contrast.

donor_fact: Temporal categories convey event structure.
bilqis_disposition: Use finite event traces with an independently executable temporal oracle.
acceptance_test: Pointwise labels must not substitute for interval truth.

donor_fact: Mood distinguishes factuality and presuppositional stance.
bilqis_disposition: Separate speaker commitment/presupposition metadata from world truth and probability.
acceptance_test: Changing mood alone must not alter the same world proposition oracle.

donor_fact: Case-scope affects the interpretation of relationships in connected material.
bilqis_disposition: Scope becomes explicit AST edges, not undocumented sequence adjacency.
acceptance_test: Nested-frame minimal pairs and dangling-scope rejection.

donor_fact: Effect and Level are distinct grammatical categories.
bilqis_disposition: Do not merge scalar level, participant impact and event phase into a numeric intensity coordinate.
acceptance_test: Each coordinate must have a distinct controlled world intervention.

donor_fact: Illocution distinguishes communicative acts such as assertion and direction.
bilqis_disposition: Attach speech-act type to utterance, not the proposition truth value.
acceptance_test: A directive is not validated as a factual assertion.

donor_fact: Validation marks evidential basis for assertive material.
bilqis_disposition: Represent basis/provenance separately from two-bit evidence support. Observation does not guarantee truth.
acceptance_test: OBS report can be mistaken; no automatic truth promotion.

donor_fact: The page has an eight-subtype phrase beside nine listed Validation categories and a stray Expectation reference.
bilqis_disposition: Use the explicitly enumerated categories for donor notes; do not invent an Expectation field or infer ML structure from editorial inconsistencies.
acceptance_test: Record source question; future parser fixture waits for reconciliation.

donor_fact: Affix scope differs by placement relative to the formative complex.
bilqis_disposition: Retain ordered scope annotations; syntactically valid reordering is not automatically semantic equivalence.
acceptance_test: Move an affix across scope boundary and require declared interpretation change.

donor_fact: Adjunct families include affixual, modular, register, suppletive, mood/case-scope, bias and parsing roles.
bilqis_disposition: Create separate node types only as supported by a world/task; no catch-all adjunct string in confirmatory input.
acceptance_test: Unknown adjunct type must fail rather than silently drop.

donor_fact: Discourse order and grammatical relations are not identical; order is not universally free.
bilqis_disposition: Test traversal only where the same explicit AST is preserved. Topic/focus differences must not be mislabeled as order-only controls.
acceptance_test: Entity serialization reversal round-trips; ordered query operands remain explicit.

donor_fact: Referential forms carry reference and associated grammatical distinctions.
bilqis_disposition: Use stable entity IDs now; add discourse binding and referential features as a separate extension.
acceptance_test: Alpha-renaming of IDs preserves meaning; rebinding does not.

donor_fact: Type 1 circumstantial and Type 2 lexicalizing concatenations differ.
bilqis_disposition: Do not map both to Boolean AND. Add typed composition operations and full scope contracts before teaching them.
acceptance_test: Circumstantial association and lexical gestalt require distinct golden ASTs.

donor_fact: Carrier constructions support names or other quoted foreign material.
bilqis_disposition: Treat carrier payload as opaque quoted data with boundaries and escaping, never executable instructions.
acceptance_test: Quoted operator strings cannot escape to AST evaluation.

source_locator: Lexicon v1.0; PDF page index 4, printed page 5
donor_fact: The copular root is restricted; its notes exclude several uses of English be.
bilqis_disposition: Keep identity/equivalence, membership, location, existence and composition separately typed. The reference EQ tests only entity-ID equality.
acceptance_test: EQ is not a shortcut for membership or descriptive predication.

donor_fact: The official lexicon supplies root/stem meaning and usage constraints.
bilqis_disposition: Expand roots only after their required semantic fields and oracle predicates exist; log unresolved sense choices.
acceptance_test: Every admitted root maps to typed senses, source location and negative examples.

donor_fact: Surface construction has morpho-phonological constraints.
bilqis_disposition: Place a reversible linguistic codec after semantic-core verification; semantic ABI does not claim valid Ithkuil spelling.
acceptance_test: AST-to-surface-to-AST equivalence plus rejection of illegal allomorphs.

donor_fact: Phonological inventory and stress participate in surface realization.
bilqis_disposition: Keep pronunciation and orthographic surface out of the first causal test.
acceptance_test: Stress-sensitive contrasts need dedicated codec fixtures.

donor_fact: The donor has dedicated number constructions.
bilqis_disposition: Current integers 0..6 are ABI numerals, not a claim to implement donor number morphology.
acceptance_test: Numeric value round-trip must be separate from donor-form acceptance.

donor_fact: The writing system is a distinct realization surface.
bilqis_disposition: Defer script tokens; a writing-system decoder cannot be assumed to improve learner reasoning.
acceptance_test: Raster/vector-to-AST testing is a separate multimodal experiment.

donor_fact: Appendices provide supplementary tables and material for the language.
bilqis_disposition: Consult for each extension; do not import every table as mandatory first-model capacity.
acceptance_test: Every new fixture cites the particular appendix section consulted.

donor_fact: Not a donor-language fact: identity is primitive in the reference world.
bilqis_disposition: Entity IDs, typed fields and exact equality.
acceptance_test: Identity and alpha-renaming; reject Boolean IDs.

donor_fact: Not a donor-language fact: finite-set operations ground toy tasks.
bilqis_disposition: Nonempty sets, cardinality, graph reachability and property comparisons.
acceptance_test: Independent BFS versus transitive-closure agreement.

donor_fact: Not a donor-language fact: operators compose with explicit typed arguments.
bilqis_disposition: Bounded-depth prefix AST; parenthesized reversible codecs.
acceptance_test: Arity, depth, type, scope and truncation rejection.

donor_fact: Not a donor-language fact: truth/falsity support uses two bits.
bilqis_disposition: UNKNOWN and CONFLICT are distinct; AND/OR/NOT defined by the evidence algebra.
acceptance_test: Exhaust all 16 binary evidence pairs and double negation.
